verdict.rationale: The evidence says Sai 'looks at the screen' and 'understands interfaces through graphic interface', and that users can watch it work. None of it documents how UI elements are actually located (accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, or coordinate grounding), so there is nothing a developer could use to debug misclicks. This is a fair question for a computer-use agent, so the axis applies and the lack of documentation means none.
